title: amico compiled Plan
description: The frontmatter of a COMPILED plan (spec-20260728 §4.1). The fleet spec's STEP schema is adopted unchanged; its plan-level frontmatter is revised here, because the hash chain needs plan_hash/design_hash and fleet §5.1 has neither. Hand-editing a compiled plan is a lint failure — the compiler is the only writer.

plan_hash.description: planHash({goal, steps}). Excludes design_hash and compiled_at so a recompile that changed nothing does not mint a new hash and invalidate a live warrant.

design_hash.description: The Spec's decision-surface hash this plan was compiled from.

suggested_ttl_s.description: A RECOMMENDATION from step_count. `amico ledger approve` reads it to default --expires-in and remains the sole writer of expires_at — compile must not own a warrant's lifetime.

steps.description: Fleet §5.1 step objects, adopted unchanged. Only `optional` is added here: it is the SOLE producer of the `skipped` step state, which the completion rule admits.

needs.description: DAG predecessors. Distinct from the compile-time capability `demands` — one name, one meaning.

advisories.description: Surviving review findings, carried as obligations. A plan cannot reach `complete` while any is open.
